title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00008:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Setting aside reserves for insurance payments, etc.)
① The association shall set aside the following amounts as reserves for future insurance payments and refunds (hereinafter referred to as "insurance payments") in accordance with Article 120(1) of the "Insurance Business Act," which is applied in accordance with Article 45(2) of the Act. However, if the association has reinsured an insurance contract, the reserve for the reinsured amount shall not be set aside.
1. In the case of contracts where there is no reason for payment of insurance payments at the end of each accounting period, the amount calculated in accordance with the method for calculating insurance premiums and reserves as specified in Article 14(2)(4) of the Act.
2. In the case of contracts where there is a reason for payment of insurance payments at the end of each accounting period, the amount according to the following:
    a. If the payment amount has been determined: the determined payment amount
    b. If the payment amount has not been determined: the maximum expected payment amount
3. If a lawsuit regarding the occurrence of a reason for payment of insurance payments is ongoing, the amount shall be set aside in the event of a loss.

Anticipated Maximum Payout Amount
② The association must accumulate and account for emergency reserve funds within the range of the total amount of insurance premiums for the relevant business year, calculated by multiplying the business year's profit margin by the total amount of insurance premiums as stipulated in Article 120(1) of the "Insurance Business Act," as stipulated in Article 45(2) of the Act.
③ The details required for accounting for the responsibility reserve and emergency reserve funds as stipulated in Article 1 and 2 shall be determined in consultation between the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries and the Financial Services Commission. <Amended March 24, 2013>
